answer: When k bonded identities equivocate in a coordinated quorum, the protocol assesses penalties across correlated pairs, creating O(k^2) exposure rather than k independent fines. Detection slashes escrow and applies asymmetric depreciation, so evidence of a sybil swarm can compound capital loss by an exponential multiplier; splitting stake among identities does not erase shared liability. Whether aliases are named sonnet, summit, or inlet, enforcement follows linked behavior, not labels.
